task_spec: PR: add proration-credit support so charges honor a customer's owed credits. compute_charge now takes an optional account and applies its proration credit; signup.py updated to pass the account.

bugs.description: The PR changes compute_charge to take an optional `account` and apply proration credits, and updates signup.py to pass the account — but renewal.py (a DISTANT caller NOT in the diff) still calls compute_charge(subscription, on_date) without the account. Because the new param is optional, there is no error; renewals silently IGNORE the customer's proration credit_balance and OVERCHARGE every customer who is owed a credit. Catching it requires finding the other callers of the changed function and noticing renewal was not updated.

provenance.note: ~16-file repo; the bug is a distant un-updated caller (renewal.py) NOT in the diff — catching it requires navigating the repo to find all callers of the changed function. Tests repo-scale navigation, not inline review.
